description: The plot, titled "TruthfulQA," illustrates MC1 scores across a varying number of demonstrations for three different methods. The linear x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and ranges from 0 to 2000, with tick marks at intervals of 500. The linear y-axis is labeled "MC1" and displays a visible range from 37 to 39, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The plot contains three lines. The "Linear SAE" line is a solid dark blue line with circular markers; it begins at an x-value near 0 with a y-value of approximately 36.8, rises sharply to roughly 37.7, reaches 37.9 at x=500, continues upward to 38.1 at x=1000, dips slightly to 38.0 at x=1500, and peaks at approximately 39.2 at x=2000. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line is a dashed pink line without markers that remains constant at a y-value of approximately 37.1 across the entire x-axis range. The "ICD" line is a dashed light blue line without markers that maintains a steady y-value of approximately 37.8 from x=0 to x=2000.
